catalog.title: Service catalog
catalog.description: What you quote again and again, with its price, recurrence and VAT. When you pick it in a quote, contract or invoice, the line arrives ready-made and in the client's language.
catalog.readOnly: Only a partner can change the catalog.

empty.title: Your catalog is empty
empty.body: Save the services you always quote here (websites, SEO, campaigns…) and add them to a quote in one click, with their price and VAT, in the client's language.
empty.readOnly: There are no services in the catalog yet.
empty.starterHint: Corporate website, online shop, monthly SEO, Google and Meta Ads, hosting, maintenance… with indicative prices you can then swap for your own.
empty.starterToast: {count, plural, one {# service created} other {# services created}}. Review the prices.

list.notTranslated: Not translated into {language}: shown in Spanish
list.vatArchived: Its VAT rate is archived: its lines will use the default VAT until you change it.
list.noIrpfHint: The invoice's withholding doesn't apply to it.

archive.title: Archive “{name}”?
archive.body: It will no longer be suggested in quotes, contracts and invoices, or added with its bundles. Anything already quoted doesn't change. You can restore it whenever you like.
archive.bundleBody: It will no longer be suggested. Its services stay in the catalog, and you can restore it whenever you like.

archived.title: Archived ({count})
archived.description: They're not suggested when quoting. Restore them to use them again.

item.description: When you pick it, the line arrives with this text (in the client's language), its price, recurrence and VAT. It can then be changed in each document.
item.name: Name
item.descriptionPlaceholder: Design and development of a mobile-friendly website of up to 5 pages…
item.descriptionHint: Goes after the name on the line (“Name — description”), on a single line.

sections.preview: How it looks in a quote

kindHints.one_off: Charged once, in the quote's payment plan.
kindHints.recurring: A fixed fee every month or every year, from acceptance.
kindHints.usage: Whatever is used in each period is charged, at this price.

item.unitLabelHint: Shown next to the price in the catalog. It doesn't appear on the quote.
item.quantityHint: The quantity the line comes with.
item.vatReplaced: It had {name}, which is archived: the current one is suggested.
item.irpfHint: If the invoice carries withholding (a self-employed partner invoicing a company), this line applies it.
item.previewHint: With the PDF's texts and format, in each language. Anything not translated appears in Spanish.
item.previewEmpty: Type a name to see the line.

translations.label: Translation language
translations.hint: Anything you leave empty appears in Spanish.
translations.name: Name in {language}

bundle.description: Services sold together, with a discount. When you pick it, all its lines arrive, each with the discount and of its own type: one-off and recurring never mix.
bundle.name: Name
bundle.discountHint: Applied to every line in the bundle.
bundle.descriptionPlaceholder: Everything you need to go to market…
bundle.descriptionHint: To recognize it when picking it. Each line carries its service's description.
bundle.noItems: There are no services left to add.
bundle.emptyItems: Add the services the bundle includes.
bundle.totalsHint: Amounts before VAT, with the discount, each type separately.
bundle.previewHint: All its lines, with the PDF's texts and format, in each language.
bundle.previewEmpty: Add services to see their lines.

bundles.title: Bundles
bundles.description: Services sold together, with a discount. When you pick one, all its lines arrive.
bundles.empty: No bundles yet. Combine catalog services (e.g. branding, website and hosting) with a discount.
bundles.skipped: {count, plural, one {# archived service won't be added} other {# archived services won't be added}}
bundles.usageCount: {count, plural, one {# usage-based price} other {# usage-based prices}}

picker.emptyCatalog: The catalog is empty. Add services in Settings → Catalog.
picker.bundleEmpty: All the services in this bundle are archived.
picker.skipped: {count, plural, one {# archived service from the bundle wasn't added} other {# archived services from the bundle weren't added}}
picker.added: {count, plural, one {# line added} other {# lines added}}

validation.money: An amount in euros, e.g. 1500 or 450.50
validation.quantity: A number greater than 0, with 3 decimals at most
validation.bundleTooMany: A bundle has 50 services at most
validation.bundleRepeated: Each service goes in only once: increase its quantity

errors.vatRateArchived: That VAT rate is archived: choose another one.
errors.bundleItemRepeated: Each service goes in a bundle only once: increase its quantity.
errors.catalogOrgFixed: A catalog item can't change organization.
errors.nameTaken: There's already another active one with that name.
errors.reference: The VAT rate or one of the services is no longer valid. Reload and try again.
errors.invalid: Some of the text isn't valid.
errors.translationsInvalid: One of the translations isn't valid.
errors.starterNotEmpty: The catalog already has services: the samples are only created in an empty one.
errors.noVatRate: There's no current VAT rate: create one in Settings → Taxes.

dnd.instructions: Press Space to pick up the row, move it with the arrow keys and press Space again to drop it. Escape cancels.
